verdict.rationale: NVIDIA claims DLSS Multi Frame Generation boosts FPS, but its own performance footnote targets 1440p, not 4K. The one independent source (TechPowerUp) says the card is marketed at 1440p and should handle native 4K only if you tune settings or use DLSS. That is qualified support for 4K, not confirmation of high-refresh 4K. Missing for 10: independent 4K game benchmark numbers (FPS/refresh-rate data), vendor 4K performance claims, and evidence that high refresh rates are sustained at 4K.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
